help.title: Help
help.intro: mw-feed works with plain forms, without JavaScript. With JavaScript enabled, actions run without reloading the page and the keyboard shortcuts below are available.
help.sc_toggle: Toggle current item (open, close item in list view)
help.sc_mark: Mark current item as read if unread or unread if read
help.sc_mark_open: Mark current item as read if unread or unread if read and open current (useful in list view and unread filter)
help.sc_next_open: Go to next item and open it (in list view)
help.sc_previous_open: Go to previous item and open it (in list view)
help.sc_open_tab: Open current item in new tab
help.sc_open_here: Open current item in current window
help.sc_read_all: Mark all items, all items from current feed or all items from current folder as read
help.sc_open_unread: Open all unread items from current page in new tabs and mark items as read
help.sc_view: Change view as list or expanded
help.sc_feeds: Show or hide list of feeds/folders
help.sc_edit: Edit current selection (all, folder or feed)
help.sc_update: Update current selection (all, folder or feed)
help.sc_reload: Reload the page as the F5 key in most of browsers
